meta.name: ESP32-S31 Korvo Board voice HA controller
meta.description: Voice- and touch-controlled room thermostat panel for a Home Assistant / zigbee2mqtt heating setup with four smart TRVs

features.text: Voice control — mic opens for one request when a front button is pressed (or the on-screen mic icon), listens ~10 s and closes again; no spoken replies, feedback on screen + LED
Wake word "Hi ESP" stays enabled as a fallback — saying it opens the same one-request listening window as the button
Spoken commands set a room's target: "set the office to 21", "living room twenty one and a half", "hallway plus one", "cancel"
Room thermostat dashboard — on-board RGB LCD shows the 4 rooms with current temperature (from the air sensors) and target (reported by each TRV)
Touch control — GT1151 touch panel selects a room and raises/lowers its target, step 0.5 °C between 5 and 30 °C
Shows the 4 smart-heated rooms — bathroom, hallway, office, living room (kitchen and bedroom have no smart TRV and stay off the screen)
Setpoints are published straight to each TRV's zigbee2mqtt MQTT topic — no Home Assistant automations involved; one fixed topic per room, editable on the web page
Setpoint command is {"current_heating_setpoint": "19.5"} on that TRV's own state topic; the device never sends a mode change, so the valves keep their current heating state

Reads each TRV's single zigbee2mqtt state topic (0xa4c1383b5b3d7063, 0xa4c13852a667eedf, 0xa4c13829e3ee602b, 0xa4c13829aa5a7009) and picks current_heating_setpoint, local_temperature and the mode out of the one JSON payload; the room air-sensor topics are set on the web page
A TRV counts as heating unless its payload says system_mode=off (missing mode or a bare heating_cooling_mode:heat also counts as heating) — today all four read as heating
Current room temperatures come from the room air sensors' zigbee2mqtt topics (the device has no thermometer of its own)
One active room at a time: tap a room card to select it, then − / + adjust its target; a background room never changes by accident
Permit-join button — one tap publishes {"time": 254} to zigbee2mqtt/bridge/request/permit_join to pair a new TRV
Local web page — SoftAP + mDNS onboarding, plus a settings page for the MQTT broker and each room's TRV / air-sensor topic and display name
Status LED (on-board WS2812 strip) — dim white = connecting, green = online, amber = listening, red = offline / command rejected
Offline behaviour — last-known values stay on screen greyed out with an "offline" note; taps/voice setpoints are refused (not queued) and the LED flashes red
At boot the dashboard comes up straight away with the last saved targets; no splash screen, no setup wizard on the panel
Anti-mistake guard — a target is only published when it differs from the last one sent; the same command twice within 30 s is ignored and the screen says "already set"
The boiler is not remote-controlled yet; the device only moves TRV setpoints and never claims to switch the heating on or off
